about: Granola's answers as they reach Tico, scrubbed: every person, company, title, id, note and token is a placeholder.
Bodies are stored decoded so they can be read; an exchange with a Content-Encoding header is served compressed.
Sources: the v0.3.4 fix (Granola gzips every answer, OAuth included), the v0.3.7 fix (notes and transcripts can
start with provider text before the XML-like body; get_meetings takes at most 10 ids; throttling arrives as HTTP
429, as a JSON-RPC error and as an isError tool result, each saying 'Rate limit exceeded. Please slow down
requests.'), Granola's MCP docs, and the 'redirect_uris must be an array' registration check seen live.
Refresh from a real account with: python scripts/granola_live_check.py --record <dir>, then read the scrub.
